ROW 3: 9 lapis velvet purse with gold embroidery overflowing with gold coins; 10 brass compass rose with old map scroll behind; 11 mason's trowel with gold handle crossed with glazed Persian tile; 12 brass mechanical clockwork automaton head with golden sword across it.
